title: C28: WaveTrend inside market structure (sell tops in downtrends, buy dots in uptrends), 1h / 2h / 4h

what.name: Trend
what.value_plain: flips down when a close breaks the last swing low, up when a close breaks the last swing high; swings = +-5 bars, known 5 bars later
what.label: OURS

what.name: Entries
what.value_plain: downtrend: sell dot at >= 53 or >= 0, buy dot at <= -53; uptrend: buy dot at <= -53 or <= 0; next bar's open
what.label: OURS

what.name: Exits compared
what.value_plain: X1 centre cross | X2 far band | X3 first opposite dot after the far band | X4 first opposite dot; trend flip ends a with-trend trade; cap 60 bars
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10% per round trip (Binance taker x2, backtest/fees.py); slippage and funding not modelled
what.label: SOURCED

how: wt_context.py on Binance spot 15m built into 1h/2h/4h. Replay = the best cell (2h uptrend buy dot <= 0, exit X3); r = net % per trade (no fixed stop).
window: 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-31, split 2022-01..2024-06 vs 2024-07..now (whole history was read: a seen-period check, not a sealed test)

verdict.label: NO for the downtrend shorts; one LEAD: 2h uptrend buy dot, exit at the first sell dot after WT reaches +53 (n 69, +0.45% net, both halves positive).

why: In a downtrend WT almost never reaches +53: 5 sell-dot-in-the-red-band trades on 1h in 2.5 years, none on 2h/4h.
Downtrend shorts at sell dots above 0 lose on every timeframe and every exit (-0.15% to -0.55% per trade).
The lead was chosen as best of about 40 cells on the same data (t 1.0): it needs a pre-registered read of 2024-07+ before anyone trusts it.

kpis.label: Sell dots in the red band during downtrends
